svg.title: AgentKit — every tool for agentic software engineering, in one kit
svg.desc: The AgentKit briefcase mark and name on a sunset-after-dark background, with cards for AgentKit's four tools — Lens, Litterbox, Switchboard and Tackle — values pills, and the throw.party mark at the foot of the tools.
